author: Reel FX Animation
title: Hiring matte painting artists for Doctor Dolittle
content: Let your talent run wild! Reel FX Animation is looking for Matte Painting Artists to work on wonderful environments for our 3D feature Doctor Dolittle: King of the Wild. Tools: Maya, Nuke, Photoshop, After Effects. Location: Montréal, 3 days/week in studio. Start date: ASAP. Apply today and show us your portfolio: https://careers.reelfx.com/apply/823?language=en
